# Bug report

## Behaviour

What happened, and what did you expect? Include a minimal YAML input, config,
command, and ryl version.

## Research

Link related open or closed issues, pull requests, and
[design decisions](https://github.com/owenlamont/ryl/blob/main/docs/design/decisions.md)
you checked. Link a prior issue if one tracks the same bug.
